主要内容: The document titled 'm2131216k.htm' is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, a Canadian financial institution, with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The filing is dated February 13, 2012, and includes information about the issuance of various senior global medium-term notes, Series E, by the Bank. These notes are linked to different indices and equity securities, including the Russell 2000® Index, S&P 500® Index, and Halliburton Company. The filing outlines the pricing, settlement dates, and principal amounts of these notes, which were issued on or after February 6, 2012. The document also references the Bank’s shelf registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-171806), indicating that the information is incorporated by reference into the Bank’s registration statement. The filing is part of the Bank’s ongoing disclosure obligations under U.S. securities laws.
